name: To Hunt a Heart
source:
After days of walking around the same trees, somehow always looping back to the start of the path, you end up trapped between a strong-willed witch and her biggest enemy. With or without their help, you must find out a way to leave the forest with no exit.

Stuck in a space loop, you can't get rid of this curse until these two souls are back together.

[From [url=https://legrandmendes.itch.io/to-hunt-a-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
